name: Traceability 4
definition: Identification of partners involved in exchange from the ATM to the issuer, with the relative timestamp of their exchanges.

RelayIdentification.name: Relay Identification
RelayIdentification.definition: Identification of a partner of a message exchange.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Identification of the relay node in the path, to enable identification of several hosts in parallel.

TraceDateTimeIn.name: Trace Date Time In
TraceDateTimeIn.definition: Date and time of incoming data exchange for relaying or processing.

TraceDateTimeOut.name: Trace Date Time Out
TraceDateTimeOut.definition: Date and time of the outgoing exchange for relaying or processing.
